State House District 61

This was our second year in the State House, representing the people of Jefferson County District 61. Since taking office in 2006, we have fought to make government more accountable and to bring fiscal responsibility back to state government. In 2008, we will focus our attention on the following four priorities:

1. REDUCING THE STATE’S DEFICIT
Colorado’s state budget has increased by nearly 40% over the last four years, yet we still face a record deficit. In 2008, we will work to reduce the state deficit through responsible cuts to state spending.
